data.body: OPERATOR RULING (2026-08-21): DECLINED as an LLM code-review criterion. The import/packaging-regression class this proposes to catch is deterministically measurable, so it gets a deterministic check instead: CI's wheel probe (.github/workflows/_artifact-probe.yml) will be extended with a full module import walk (importlib walk of every rebar.* module in the clean wheel venv, plus a scripts/ import leg) with a locally runnable entry point. Filed as a separate task; see 5bca-4ca9 for the full adjudication trail. Related prior ruling: ci-gate-compat likewise rejected (6f2e-58a5). Closing this ticket unimplemented.
